messages:
Nora Patel: Heads up — I need to move our weekly inference benchmarking readout this week, conflict with a customer dive. Can we swap slots or do a short async handoff?
Aaron Kim: Thanks for flagging. Which slot did you have originally?
Nora Patel: Original was Thu 11:00-11:45 PT. I can offer Tue 09:30-10:15 PT or Fri 13:00-13:45 PT.
Liz Chen: Tue morning is rough for me. Friday lunchtime works better.
Sam O'Neill: I prefer Tue otherwise I won't have the new latency graphs ready by Friday (still ingesting overnight runs).
Alex Ruiz: @Nora can you drop a 10-min pre-read in the agenda with the key numbers? I can do Fri but only if we keep to 30m.
Nora Patel: Yep — plan was 30m readout + 10m q/a. Proposed short agenda: 1) quick context + perf target, 2) latency/cost delta since quant changes, 3) top 2 regressions and mitigations, 4) action items.
Maria Gomez: Can we add a tiny section for canary rollout metrics? One datapoint should be enough.
Nora Patel: Good call — will add.
Aaron Kim: OK do a quick poll: Tue 09:30 or Fri 13:00. If majority prefers Tue we'll keep but I'll try to help Sam get graphs earlier.
bench-bot: Poll created: "Bench readout slot" — options: Tue 09:30, Fri 13:00. Poll closes in 24h.
Liz Chen: voted Fri 13:00
Sam O'Neill: voted Tue 09:30
Alex Ruiz: voted Fri 13:00
Maria Gomez: voted Fri 13:00
Aaron Kim: Looks like Fri 13:00 wins. Nora — can you confirm you can do Fri with 30m? If not, we can fallback to async thread.
Nora Patel: Confirmed: Fri 13:00-13:30 PT. I'll post a 2-slide pre-read and link to the dashboard by Thu EOD.
Alex Ruiz: Thanks. Thumbs up for tight agenda.
Liz Chen: I'll prepare the cost breakdown slide and call out the batching/kv-cache impact.
Sam O'Neill: I'll try to push the final latency graphs earlier — may post them in thread as soon as they're ready.
Aaron Kim: @bench-bot can you create a calendar event for Fri 13:00-13:30 PT and add eng-ml, eng-runtime, and product-observability?
bench-bot: Calendar event created: "Inference bench readout — short" Fri 13:00-13:30 PT. Invitees: eng-ml, eng-runtime, product-observability. Link: https://calendar.example/evt/abc123
Nora Patel: Agenda (final):
```
- 13:00 (2m) quick context + perf target recap
- 13:02 (10m) latency delta post-quant/size change (Sam)
- 13:12 (8m) cost delta + batching notes (Liz)
- 13:20 (5m) canary metric callout + rollback trigger (Maria)
- 13:25 (5m) actions & owners
```
I'll upload slides + dashboard link Thu EOD.
Maria Gomez: If anyone can't make it, please drop comments on the pre-read — we'll triage asynchronously.
Alex Ruiz: Noted. Also can we add a quick item for "fallback model variant" decisions if regression > 5%? Even 30s to call it out would be helpful.
Nora Patel: Good point — adding a one-line decision rule to actions.
Aaron Kim: Thanks everyone. See you Fri, will try to be there for the Sam time slot if needed.
Liz Chen: :thumbsup:
Sam O'Neill: will post graphs to the thread by Thu 22:00 PT if all goes well.
Nora Patel: Closing for now — will ping again when pre-read is posted. Thanks!
